mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) may potentiate cholinergic effects of galantamine and increase risk of syncope, bradycardia, and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium levels, and assess for symptoms of bradycardia or syncope; consider ECG monitoring if clinically indicated.
